name: Dili International Marathon 2026
short_description: Dili International Marathon 2026 is a verified Full/Half/10K/5K event in Dili, Timor-Leste, confirmed for 8 August 2026 with open registration.
ai_summary: Dili International Marathon 2026, themed "Love Our Forests and Wildlife," is organized by the Federacao de Timor-Leste de Atletismo and confirmed for 8 August 2026 in Dili. The event offers a Full Marathon, Half Marathon, Para 10K, and 5K Fun Run, with registration open via the official site. Pricing is differentiated: international entrants pay $45 (Half) or $90 (Full) in USD, while Timorese nationals run free. Verified against the official race website as of 20 July 2026 with a confidence score of 90.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to enter the Dili International Marathon?
faqs.answer: International runners pay USD 45 for the Half Marathon or USD 90 for the Full Marathon. Timorese nationals can enter either distance for free. Registration is open now through the event's official website, though no specific registration deadline has been published yet.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Dili International Marathon?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distances: a Full Marathon (42.195km), a Half Marathon (21.1km), a Para 10K category, and a 5K Fun Run. This range makes the event accessible to competitive marathoners, first-time half-marathon runners, para-athletes, and casual participants at the same race weekend.
